title: DéGame
tagline: Enter the world of the decentralized Liar's Dice: where bluff meets blockchain, and trust is shared into every roll.
description: DéGame is a platform that brings a digital dimension to the most famous dice games. Its objective is to allow players to use the benefits of Web 3 to enjoy the most famous and funny dice games. Starting with Liar's Dice, a game about strategy and bluffing, we aim to use blockchain technology to bring games that travelled cross ages into the decentralized era.
how_its_made:
DéGame is built on top of Inco, a layer-1 blockchain which integrates Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE). It enables players to see secret information, such as their secret dice, that won't be accessible to anyone else, such as their secret , while still allowing a smart contract, who's acting as the game master, to manage game rooms.
As DéGame is addressed to people from all ages, DéGame is using the Dynamic wallet provider, allowing people without blockchain knowledge to enjoy DéGame as simply as using their email.
